name: RAGManager
description: Ingest websites, PDFs, and files into the local knowledge base so they can be queried later

functions.name: scanUrl
functions.description: Crawl and ingest a website or URL into the local knowledge base for future queries
functions.output_format: Confirmation message stating how many chunks were inserted from the URL

functions.name: scanFile
functions.description: Ingest an uploaded file into the local knowledge base for future queries
functions.output_format: Confirmation message stating how many chunks were inserted from the file

functions.name: listDatasets
functions.description: List all files and URLs currently indexed in the local knowledge base
functions.output_format: List of all indexed sources with their table name and chunk count

functions.name: removeSource
functions.description: Remove a specific file or URL from the local knowledge base
functions.output_format: Confirmation that the source was removed from the knowledge base
